column1: # Current catalog: composed operability source f01a9ef9 (diagnostics, Time, logging,
# SSH priority, local console, SFTP and the provenance follow-up; #148).
# The C kit links the accepted Rust runtime: all 18 raw and stripped digests change.
# Fresh host discovery: USERLAND BUILD OK ports=18 reproducible=2 gate=18
# unresolved=0 host_cases=183. The pin commit is rebuilt and sealed separately.
# The base userland's ports installed under /bin (userland/README.md,
# scripts/build-ports.sh, copies each into ports/NAME; scripts/operator_image.py
# PORTS names the same utilities, so the operator image and a release carry
#   NAME          the /bin name (no platform command, builtin or other port has it)
#   UPSTREAM      the userland/PIN row the sources come from (NAME-VERSION)
#   SOURCE        the upstream file; the patches in userland/patches/ name theirs
#   BUILD         the ELF scripts/build-userland.sh builds and gates, relative to
#   GATED_SHA256  that ELF's digest (check-c-elf.py --map passed; two rounds equal)
#   SHA256 BYTES  ports/NAME: BUILD stripped with llvm-strip-18, as the Rust ports are
# A digest that changes (the kit, the adapter, a patch or the pin changed) is
# refused by the install; record the new rows (install-userland-ports.sh
# --print) only with that change, once it is reviewed.
